messages.content: You are an independent architecture examiner. Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Distinguish commitment/authority from truth, provider output from customer assay, deterministic service derivation from language-model inference, and protocol records from authoritative semantic claims.

Review this bounded implementation design for category errors. A customer authors a witnessed token/claim work lot committing its context. Witnessed ServiceCapabilityClaim lots assign provider/contract tokens to typed capabilities with availability=unknown and targetAcceptanceRequired=true. PyMetroLogic FCA derives the extent covering intent plus execution-class:deterministic-service. Only candidates in that extent receive ActivityStreams solicitations; comparable positive-integer offers are ranked by price. A Chu-Hoare effect cell must name the selected service-token actor as provider. Both enterprises sign off-chain EIP-712 authority, then separately sign and close a HolonomySeamLedger entry; execution independently reads isClosed. The selected provider returns a result. A customer-supplied assayer function, not provider output, emits CustomerResultAssay{assay,accepted,basis}; the effect receipt commits those customer assay bytes. Finance uses a customer-recomputed commodity-lot assay. Cryptographic keccak256 uses a customer-owned published-vector comparison. Both spend zero model calls. If FCA has no extent or no live comparable offer, a typed UnresolvedTokenClaimResidue alone may be offered to LISS; model output remains candidate-pending-customer-assay. JSON/Node are replayable projections; EVM binds the traversal but does not prove truth. Identify any remaining category error or authority leak in this design, without proposing a global registry or model-first dispatcher.
